definitions.explanation: The right to block a decision single-handedly, best known as the power held by the five permanent members of the UN Security Council and by the US president over bills passed by Congress.

examples.japanese: {拒否権|きょひけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{常任|じょうにん}{理事国|りじこく}→常任理事国：31769_jouninrijikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拒否権|きょひけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The permanent members have veto power.

examples.japanese: {一国|いっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拒否権|きょひけん}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{安保理|あんぽり}→安保理：18113_anpori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{決議案|けつぎあん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Security Council resolution was voted down by one country's veto.
